records.name: Benas
records.facts_used: The Senn–Salys dictionary explicitly identifies Benas as a short form of Benediktas. The exact form is documented in the Senn–Salys Lithuanian–German dictionary of 1968, reprinted in Salys’s collected writings in 1983. This is a dated linguistic record of the name and its relationships; it does not identify the first child registered with this spelling.
